issues.on_page: Local 82,568 (p4 Road Fund column: Local 4,091 + Sale of surplus 78,477 = 82,568)
issues.issue: The Road Fund budget-schedule 'Local' line is about 95% sale of surplus, as the report itself prints on p4. Under the mixed-line rule the dominant category (sale of assets / detail 'sale of assets') applies, with a review note. 'other' is not the right category.

issues.on_page: Local 191,735 (p6: Private Foundation Fund Local 175,000; p2 shows 175,000 as Operating Grants and Contributions)
issues.issue: About 91% of this nonmajor 'Local' line is Private Foundation money, which p2 classes as grants and contributions. donations/contributions (dominant category, with review) looks like a better fit than other.
The General Fund budget 'Local' line includes sale of surplus 7,470 (p5: 521,692 + 7,470). It is a broad mixed group with no dominant component printed, so 'other' with review is defensible.

Broad 'Local' group. p2 lists charges for services 443,036, interest income 73,961 and miscellaneous 324,269 (government-wide), but this line isn't broken down. 'other' with review is defensible, but it puts about 7.6% of receipts in other.
Matches p8, but p4/p5 print General Fund Taxes as 5,077,938. Total expenditures are 4,264,243 on p8 vs 4,264,244 on p5. These are $1 rounding differences in the report itself.
Road Fund intergovernmental receipts are most likely mainly highway allocation. This is a guess either way, since the report doesn't itemize them.
